# Hash Future School

> Hash Future School is an AI-first online learning community focused on future-ready skills, self-directed learning, entrepreneurship, and meaningful education for children.

## Primary URL
- https://www.hashfuture.school/

## Key Pages
- Home: https://www.hashfuture.school/
- About: https://www.hashfuture.school/about.html
- Super Kids (student spotlights): https://www.hashfuture.school/super-kids.html
- Future Talks (youth entrepreneurship summit): https://www.hashfuture.school/future-talks.html
- Future Talks - Apply to Speak: https://www.hashfuture.school/future-talks-apply.html
- International Junior Entrepreneurship Challenge (IJEC): https://www.hashfuture.school/ijec.html
- Blog: https://www.hashfuture.school/blog.html

## Awards & Recognition
- VBA Business Awards recognition (Kerala)
- Best Innovative School Award at World School Summit 2024 (Dubai)

## Programs and Focus Areas
- AI-first learning approach
- Entrepreneurship and financial literacy
- Communication and confidence building
- Self-directed, real-world project-based learning
